title: Find packs shared with you
description: Find received Dub and Sample Packs in the matching shared section and open their scoped playlists.

steps.caption: 1. Open Dubs shared with you to find received releases, including private Dub Packs.
2. The release appears once as a pack card. Expand it to see the individual files.
3. Samples shared with you is separate and uses the green sample palette.
4. Open pack launches the fullscreen player with only this Sample Pack's files.
5. Access can be revoked by the uploader. Downloading never grants sample reuse permission.
